value.rationale: Two-hub contact structures naturally represent redundant contact channels. The exact sharp 9-vertex onset resolves when a risk-detection pair should mix central and peripheral positions: for all smaller examples it never dominates, while beyond the threshold it robustly defeats both same-type pairings. This rejects blanket core-only or disperse-only placement heuristics in a natural minimal multi-path outbreak network, without relying on arbitrary decimal gains. Precise object and invariant are epidemic detection probability over a uniform-source ensemble.
